title: A network dashboard for the Switch

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How good is the Wi-Fi on your Nintendo Switch? There's a dashboard for that.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's switch-wifi, a network dashboard with an interface built on Borealis.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The metric calculations are portable code, kept apart from the console application.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because you can test the core on a regular computer, without the whole Switch toolchain. Fast checks, same logic.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's native C plus plus, built with CMake, and talks to the Switch's wlan services. The full write-up has the layout.
